sources.title: Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: The exact instruction-tuned checkpoint card names Meta, reports 90B (88.8) parameters for the complete vision model, text/image input and text output, and visual question-answering/captioning use cases.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 release announcement
sources.evidence: September 25, 2024 announcement releases both pretrained and instruction-tuned 11B/90B vision models with downloadable weights; describes the vision encoder and cross-attention adapter added to the language model.

sources.title: Official exact model architecture registry
sources.evidence: The Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct entry specifies 80 language layers, width 8192, 64 attention heads, 8 KV heads and 20 vision cross-attention layers, with 560-pixel image tiles.

sources.title: Official Llama model families and context limits
sources.evidence: Maps the exact 90B Vision Instruct identifier to Llama 3.2; max_seq_length returns 131072 for its default BF16 format. The 8192 exception concerns int4 models.

sources.title: Official Llama multimodal Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: Implements dense vision and language Transformer blocks, a vision projection, and dense gated cross-attention blocks with SwiGLU feed-forward layers; the model registry determines the exact layer counts.

sources.title: Official Llama 3.2 Vision prompt and tool format
sources.evidence: Documents built-in and zero-shot tool calling using the Llama 3.1 format with text-only inputs, and explicitly states tool calling does not work with images in the prompt.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Custom license dated September 25, 2024 grants conditioned use and redistribution of weights, incorporates the acceptable-use policy, and imposes additional terms above 700 million monthly active users.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Acceptable Use Policy
sources.evidence: For the multimodal models, the license grant excludes EU-domiciled individuals and companies whose principal place of business is in the EU; the exception covers end users of incorporating products or services.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401. No access gate was bypassed and no weight shards were downloaded; public Meta registry and implementation supply architecture/context evidence.

developer.note: Developer identified by the official card and announcement.

family.note: The exact model belongs to Llama 3.2 within the catalog’s broader Llama family.

release_date.note: Original public release includes the instruction-tuned 90B vision variant; day precision is explicit.

open_weights.note: Downloadable weights under a custom license and access conditions; this does not imply an unrestricted open-source license.

license.note: Custom license incorporating the AUP. Multimodal license rights exclude EU-domiciled individuals and EU-principal-place-of-business companies, with an exception for end users of incorporating products/services.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported complete multimodal count in billions: 90B is the nominal tier and 88.8B the parenthetical precision. Includes language, vision, and adapter components; not a tensor-exact count or a storage-size calculation.

active_parameters_b.note: A separate active-parameter count is not reported. Dense architecture does not justify copying the total, particularly because image and text-only processing use different paths.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive language Transformer with a vision encoder/projection and cross-attention adapter. Exact 90B Instruct registry: 80 language layers plus 20 cross-attention layers, width 8192, 64 query heads and 8 KV heads.

context_window.note: The exact model maps to the non-int4 Llama 3.2 registry limit of 131072 tokens; this resolves the card’s abbreviated 128k.

modalities.note: Text-only and text-plus-image prompts generate text.

reasoning.note: Visual reasoning and CoT benchmark results do not establish a dedicated reasoning/thinking mode; none is documented in the inspected card or prompt specification.

tool_call.note: Native built-in and zero-shot tool-call formats are documented for text-only prompts. Meta explicitly excludes prompts containing images.

description.value: Instruction-tuned dense vision-language model with 88.8B reported parameters, supporting visual question answering, document understanding, captioning, and text chat.
description.note: Replaces the vague large/open wording with supported model size, dense architecture, instruction tuning and intended tasks.

patch.description: Instruction-tuned dense vision-language model with 88.8B reported parameters, supporting visual question answering, document understanding, captioning, and text chat.

Official Llama 3.2 Vision prompt and tool format

patch.notes: Meta reports 88.8B complete multimodal parameters (nominal 90B), at developer-reported precision. Architecture combines 80 language Transformer layers with 20 vision cross-attention layers. Context is 131072 tokens. Native tool calling applies only to text-only prompts; image prompts are excluded. The custom license incorporates the AUP’s EU multimodal restriction and end-user exception. Active parameter count and dedicated reasoning mode are not separately disclosed.

summary: Corrects the nominal 90B count to Meta’s reported complete 88.8B, identifies dense vision-language architecture and 20 cross-attention layers, and corrects context to 131072. Clears unsupported reasoning=false; active count remains undisclosed. Confirms original September 25 release, weights, license and modalities, with explicit image-prompt tool-call and EU license limitations. Exact HF config access returned 401; public Meta source code independently verifies context and architecture.
